title: Consolidated Financial Statements
summary: Establishes principles for presenting consolidated financial statements when an entity controls one or more other entities, substantially converged with IFRS 10.

bannerNotice.title: Substantially converged with IAS/IFRS
bannerNotice.body: Ind AS 110 reproduces IFRS 10's power/returns/linkage control model almost exactly. The key Indian nuance concerns how the investment entities exception interacts with India's SEBI-regulated mutual fund and AIF structures.
